mapper.insert: INSERT INTO forum_posts (user_id, product_id, body, parent_id) VALUES (#{userId},#{productId}, #{body}, #{parentId})
mapper.select: SELECT p.*, u.name AS userName FROM forum_posts p JOIN users u ON p.user_id = u.id WHERE p.parent_id IS NULL AND p.product_id = #{productId} ORDER BY p.created_at DESC
